card.title: Terms and Conditions
card.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder for two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One lift, then. And tell your wife my roses have improved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five pounds. Three if you say we're still friends when you hand it over.

mechanism: A prices a ladder favor, praise and friendship reassurance as exchangeable terms.
confusable: Unlike merely charging for equipment, emotional reassurance and social credit must enter the bargain too.
comparison: D22-a discounts payment for spoken friendship; D22-b prices genuine forgiveness in holiday time.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
